title: The Black Hole Slope
blurb: Black holes aren't a bunch of dots on this chart: they sit on one line, the top-left edge of everything.

segments.from: I've been doing a series of videos

_note: Ends on the Black Hole Slope's own ending (rec59, 2026-11-09), from "But the most interesting question" to "tiny black holes" (the author, 2026-11-09: the cut ending at 'but how small' felt cut in half; trying whether the two recordings sit together). Before: to 'but how small'; before that, to 'bigger than Pluto's orbit'. Its ending plays at 1.1x, the pace of the rest (the author, 2026-11-09). At the join (the author, 2026-11-09: a silence, the music stopping, a stutter, more echo in the new voice): one Mesmerize under the whole video, the camera carried on from video 4's scene, and a small room added to rec48's voice to match rec59's (room).
